requirements.summary: Document and validate the existing build/publish flow so the current site version (including existing GIF updates) can be released without further feature changes.
acceptanceCriteria: A new build is created from the current codebase state without requiring additional code changes.
The deployed/published version reflects the latest frontend assets and pages already updated (e.g., Home/Hero and Services GIF usage).
No regressions: the site loads successfully and key pages render without runtime errors after publishing.

file_operations.description: Add a concise runbook for triggering the existing build and publish/release flow for this project, including a pre-publish checklist that confirms the already-implemented GIF assets are present and referenced (e.g., frontend/src/components/Hero.tsx and frontend/src/components/Services.tsx), and a post-publish smoke-test checklist to ensure key sections render without runtime errors. Reference the repo’s existing publishing tooling/template (e.g., github-export-icp-cli) as the source of the publish flow and remind maintainers to Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
